text:
If tonight's on your porch list, this is the one to take, clear skies settling in with the sun already down and temps easing toward the low 60s by morning. Winds are going light and variable on the lake, so if you're still out there it'll lay down glassy calm, just watch that water's still a steamy 77.

Wednesday's the flip side. Sunny to start, high near 81 again, but the forecasters have been dialing up shower and thunderstorm chances through the afternoon as a system works in, call it 40 percent with a stray rumble possible. The American model's a bit more bullish on rain than the European or Canadian guidance, so there's real spread on how wet it actually gets, but I'd keep the umbrella within reach past midday just in case. Air quality's a non-issue, good and clean. Good, calm window for the water tonight and into tomorrow morning; by early afternoon Wednesday I'd have half an eye on the sky if you're planning to be out on the lake.

week.blurb: Mostly sunny and comfortable with a high near 81, about as dry a Tuesday as you'll get this week.
Sunny start gives way to afternoon storms, high near 81; I'd keep the rain jacket handy since some models run wetter than others.
Showers and thunderstorms likely most of the day, high near 80, so plan around the wet with an umbrella close by.
Cooler and noticeably drier moves in Friday, high near 75, just a stray shower chance early on.
Sunny and crisp, high near 77, about as ideal an outdoor Saturday as Vermont gets.
Pleasant and partly sunny by day, high near 79, but storms build back in after dark.
Showers likely return Monday, high near 79, with the wet weather clearing out by evening.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: Cooler and noticeably drier air arrives Friday under partly sunny skies with highs near 75° and overnight lows in the mid-50s. High pressure then centers over Vermont and the North Country for the weekend, delivering ideal outdoor weather. Saturday will be bright and sunny with highs near 74° and crisp dewpoints in the 40s and 50s. Sunday starts partly sunny and pleasant with highs reaching 76°, before an isolated afternoon shower (25% chance) gives way to widespread rain overnight (50% chance) and into Monday morning. Rain clears Monday afternoon leaving partly sunny skies with highs near 79°, setting up a mostly sunny Tuesday with highs near 80°.
